records.text: A Defias Brotherhood henchman in Westfall who threatens opposition with the Brotherhood’s power and eagerly welcomes a chance to use a freshly sharpened blade.
A brainwashed noble in Westfall.
A Defias miner who uses Pierce Armor in combat.
Marisa du'Paige is a rare humanoid whose combat repertoire includes Fireball, Polymorph: Chicken, Sleep, and Chains of Ice.
A Defias conjurer in Westfall.
A goblin engineer whose combat spells include Summon Remote-Controlled Golem.
An undead skeletal miner in Westfall.
An undead excavator in Westfall.
An undead dynamiter in Westfall.

Foreman Thistlenettle is an undead foreman in Westfall and Wilder Thistlenettle’s brother. Wilder recalls that his brother was among those missing after a mine beneath a Moonbrook barn collapsed, and that he always carried an Explorers’ League badge.
A Defias overseer in the Deadmines.
A Defias blackguard in the Deadmines who conceals itself outside combat and springs from the shadows.

Edwin VanCleef is the Defias kingpin in the Deadmines. Shaw’s report describes him as the former head of the Stonemasons’ Guild who rebuilt Stormwind after the First War, apparently resentful with his men of their treatment by the King afterward. VanCleef insists the Brotherhood’s cause is righteous and will prevail, calls allies from the shadows, and dismisses opponents as lapdogs.
A Goblin Woodcarver is a humanoid combatant who can use Axe Toss and Cleave in combat.
Sneed's Shredder is a mechanical shredder with the title Lumbermaster; it can cast Terrify.
Rhahk'Zor is the foreman in the Deadmines. He threatens attackers by declaring that VanCleef pays well for their heads, and fights with a slam that stuns his opponent.
Cookie is the ship's cook in the Deadmines. In combat, Cookie splashes acid at nearby enemies and uses cooking to restore health.

Mr. Smite is the ship's first mate in the Deadmines. He orders the crew to investigate suspicious noise and repel invaders. Tougher opponents surprise him and prompt him to improvise; he voices anger as the fight continues.
Captain Greenskin is a captain in the Deadmines who fights with cleaving blows and a poisoned harpoon.
A Defias Pirate is a humanoid pirate who can cast Bloodsail Companion while out of combat.
A Defias digger in Westfall who invokes the Brotherhood’s power and warns opponents that it will not tolerate their actions.
A Defias watchman who can shoot at opponents at range.

A Defias magician encountered among the Defias in Westfall, it uses frost armor before combat, hurls fireballs in battle, and can summon a living flame. Its arcane training marks it as a magical combatant in the gang’s ranks.
A Defias worker found among the gang’s forces in Westfall, this worker is a combatant despite the name, and flees for assistance when badly hurt.
The Defias Evoker is a combatant whose routine includes casting Frost Armor while out of combat. That defensive spell gives this evoker a distinct preparation before a fight.
The Goblin Craftsman is an ore-working combatant: its routine casts Melt Ore during combat. When nearly defeated, it flees for assistance, suggesting it does not hold its ground once badly hurt.
The Defias Squallshaper is a combatant with a small set of distinct spells: it casts Frost Armor out of combat and Fire Blast in combat.

Gilnid, known as the Smelter, directs workers to move parts to the ship and berates them when they ask for a break. His sharp orders make him a demanding overseer of the smelting work. In combat he uses Molten Metal.
Miner Johnson is a named miner who uses Pierce Armor.
The Goblin Shipbuilder tries to escape and summon help when reduced to very low health. Its instinct is to survive a losing fight rather than stay and be overwhelmed.
Named for a mining trade, the Defias Strip Miner brings Pierce Armor to combat. Its identity is grounded in labor, with a piercing attack that marks it as a fighter as well as a worker.
The Defias Taskmaster, a figure associated with supervision by its title, uses ranged attacks such as Shoot and Piercing Shot when fighting.
The Defias Wizard brings fire magic to combat, using Fireball against opponents. The title marks a magical role, and the spell gives that role a clear, destructive expression in battle.
